newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Amtek gets nod to list unit in Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Amtek gets nod to list unit in Malaysia.

text.p: Amtek Engineering Ltd said on Monday it has received in principle approval from the Securities Commission of Malaysia for the listing of its 63 percent-owned Malaysian subsidiary Kris Component Sdn Bhd.
Amtek said based on the proposed share offer price of 2.60 ringgit per share, the group would realise a capital gain of Singapore $3.4 million from the sale of 5.68 million shares in Kris.
Amtek said after the public offering its stake in Kris would be diluted to 43 percent. Net proceeds for the sale will be used for its future investments, it added.
